snippet.title: RuneCipher - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
RuneCipher is a tactics RPG that evolves the turn-based strategy genre into something new: a combination of strategic gameplay and active combat that is built on a stamina system which governs the action economy. 

You play as Noni, a young member of an adventurer's guild that seeks an ancient relic to save one of their own. Explore the vestiges of an ancient civilization, and master time magic to bring back a long lost power. 

wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4689550/RuneCipher/

Developer: Rasmalai Studios
